scope: Ngo Bao Chau CSS compatibility audit across all 29 screens

audit.typedLengthDivision: No length/length scale expression found in application CSS; existing length/numeric arithmetic retained
audit.propertyDependency: Original desktop nested About container needed @property --u to freeze inherited cqw. Removing that rule shrank the first title from 227.80px to 87.83px
audit.fix: Removed unnecessary desktop choice container and @property declaration. Title remains 227.80px without registration; mobile choices keep a separate container and fixed base unit
audit.resizeObservers: Navigation and reduced-motion orbit DOM writes deferred to RAF with cleanup; navigation skips identical height writes, avoiding WebKit notification loops

qa.checks: Decoded media, SVG source ratios/bounds, inherited units, About caption gaps and horizontal overflow passed
qa.runtime: No application errors, warnings, failed HTTP responses or ResizeObserver loop notifications in the successful matrix runs
qa.interactions: Section Space loops, content blackout preserving menu, rapid navigation, Back/Forward, startup reset and CSS HMR verified
qa.orbitRegression: Certificate keyboard selection/source assets and smooth five-planet movement verified after observer changes

documentation.agents: D:/Web/AGENTS.md: concise policy for structure, compatibility, assets and engine/viewport QA
documentation.skill: D:/Web/SKILL.md: project tree, SVG/container failures, native graph fallback, typography spacing, Safari/touch, transitions, orbit/ResizeObserver, asset packing/Git and real project lessons
documentation.validation: UTF-8, anchors, links, fences and skill-creator quick_validate passed; documents are outside a Git repository

limitations: Windows-hosted browser engines and Retina emulation; no physical Mac test. Core layout still targets browsers supporting container units/queries and small viewport units; this is not a claim of support for every obsolete browser
